name: Fragrance ~Ryoujoku no Choukou~
original_name: フレグランス～凌辱の調香～
source:
Main character's sister has become a doll-like being after some event. Protagonist tries to investigate it and finds a note with three sister names on it. His revenge is going to be remorseless.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角的妹妹因为某件事而变成了洋娃娃一样的存在。主角试图调查此事，并发现了一张纸条，上面写着三个姐妹的名字。他的复仇将是无情的。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
